parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

rds_intl: Subscription primary instance.

</props>

parameters.name: commodity_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to obtain the instance ID.
When you query the list of instance types for read-only instances, which means you specify the commodity code of a read-only instance for the CommodityCode parameter, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。可调用DescribeDBInstances获取。
查询只读实例规格列表，即CommodityCode参数中传入只读实例商品码时，本参数必传
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The order type to query. Valid values:
BUY: Purchase.
UPGRADE: Upgrade.
RENEW: Renewal.
CONVERT: Billing method conversion
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的订单类型，取值：
BUY：新购。
UPGRADE：变更配置。
RENEW：续费。
CONVERT：转换付费类型
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:

If you use an Alibaba Cloud international site account, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取。
如果您使用的是阿里云国际站账号，此参数必传
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The response parameters are as follows

Items.description_en: The list of instance type information

ClassCode.description_en: The instance type code. For more information, see [Primary instance types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html） and [Read-only instance types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html）
ClassCode.description_zh: 实例规格代码。更多信息，请参见[主实例规格列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html）和[只读实例规格列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145759.html）

ClassGroup.description_en: The instance family. For more information, see [Instance families]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57184.html）
ClassGroup.description_zh: 实例规格族。更多信息，请参见[实例规格族]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57184.html）

Cpu.description_en: The number of CPU cores for the instance type. Unit: cores
Cpu.description_zh: 实例规格对应的CPU核数。单位：个

EncryptedMemory.description_en: The encrypted memory size of the security-enhanced instance family. Unit: GB
EncryptedMemory.description_zh: 安全增强型实例规格加密内存大小。单位：GB

InstructionSetArch.description_en:
The architecture type of the instance type. Valid values:

If the instance uses the x86 architecture, this parameter is left empty by default.
If the instance uses the arm architecture, arm is returned
InstructionSetArch.description_zh:
实例规格所属架构类型，返回值如下：

如果是实例为x86架构，默认该参数返回值为空。
如果是实例为arm架构，则返回arm

MaxConnections.description_en: The maximum number of connections for the instance type
MaxConnections.description_zh: 实例规格对应的最大连接数。单位：个

MaxIOMBPS.description_en: The maximum I/O bandwidth for the instance type. Unit: Mbps
MaxIOMBPS.description_zh: 实例规格对应的最大IO带宽。单位：Mbps

MaxIOPS.description_en: The maximum IOPS for the instance type. Unit: operations per second
MaxIOPS.description_zh: 实例规格对应的最大IOPS。单位：次/秒

MemoryClass.description_en: The memory capacity for the instance type. Unit: GB
MemoryClass.description_zh: 实例规格对应的内存容量。单位：GB

ReferencePrice.description_en:
The price of the instance type.

<props="china">
Unit: cents (CNY).
</props>
<props="intl">
Unit: cents (USD).
</props>

If you specify a pay-as-you-go commodity code for the CommodityCode parameter, this parameter displays the hourly price.
If you specify a subscription commodity code for the CommodityCode parameter, this parameter displays the monthly price
ReferencePrice.description_zh:
实例规格对应的价格。

<props="china">
单位：分（人民币）。
</props>
<props="intl">
单位：分（美元）。
</props>

CommodityCode参数中传入按量付费商品码时，本参数展示每小时的价格。
CommodityCode参数中传入包年包月商品码时，本参数展示每月的价格

category.description_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:
Regular instances
    * Basic: Basic Edition.
    * HighAvailability: High-availability Edition.
    * cluster: Cluster Edition for MySQL or PostgreSQL.
    * AlwaysOn: Cluster Edition for SQL Server.
    * Finance: RDS Enterprise Edition.
Serverless instances
    * serverless_basic: Serverless Basic Edition. (Applicable only to MySQL and PostgreSQL)
    * serverless_standard: Serverless High-availability Edition. (Applicable only to MySQL and PostgreSQL)
    * serverless_ha: Serverless High-availability Edition for SQL Server
category.description_zh:
实例系列，取值：
常规实例
    * Basic：基础系列。
    * HighAvailability：高可用系列。
    * cluster：MySQL或PostgreSQL集群系列。
    * AlwaysOn：SQL Server集群系列。
    * Finance：三节点企业系列。
Serverless实例
    * serverless_basic：Serverless基础系列。（仅适用MySQL和PostgreSQL）
    * serverless_standard：Serverless高可用系列。（仅适用MySQL和PostgreSQL）
    * serverless_ha：SQL Server Serverless高可用系列
